request: Advanced-route deliverable: grant-outcome equity. Pull CDC PLACES county-level health-outcomes (2023) as a NEED proxy. Publish a PLACES-focused DS keyed on county+measure that operators can pivot in Tableau. State-level FY24 SLED grant totals come from the existing flow #3 output at dashboard-time. This is the CANONICAL pass-3 proxy-substitution demo: real grant outcomes aren't available, so we substitute health-outcome burden as a need proxy.

sources.name: CDC PLACES County Health 2023 (Equity view)
sources.description: CDC PLACES 2023 county-level health metrics filtered to health_outcomes (categoryid=HLTHOUT) via SoQL, one row per (county, measure). ~90k rows filtered to HLTHOUT.

outputs.name: PLACES Health Outcome Burden Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level 2023 CDC PLACES health-outcomes data (categoryid=HLTHOUT) filtered from chronicdata.cdc.gov swc5-untb. One row per (county, measure). Fields: year, state (stateabbr + statedesc), county (locationname), 5-digit FIPS (locationid), category, measure, measureid, short_question_text, data_value, totalpopulation, value_band (low/moderate/elevated/high threshold binning). Refresh: monthly (aligned with PLACES release cadence).

Advanced-route notes: this is the NEED-proxy leg of the grant-outcome equity analysis (pass-3 proxy substitution). Real grant OUTCOME data (recipient-level performance, program-effectiveness metrics) is NOT publicly available at scale — declared RED for the outcome factor. We substitute PLACES health-outcome burden as a NEED PROXY. Join at Tableau layer to 'SLED Grants FY24 Detail' aggregated by state (stateabbr) to compute equity_ratio = grant_$_per_capita / burden_per_capita. Ratios diverging from 1 indicate DOLLARS-VS-NEED mismatch — a DIAGNOSTIC signal, not a normative equity determination. Trend analysis would require multi-year data (PLACES is annual and this pull is single-year), so the DS is a static snapshot.
